description: This file is an HTML document that provides a web-based user interface for visualizing databases, listing databases and tables, and displaying table data with interactive features.
external_methods: fetchData (fetches JSON data from API endpoints)

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches list of databases and renders them in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, resetting the interface.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database to show its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads and displays tables of the selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data of the selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Builds and inserts an HTML table from data array.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell contents, handling objects and long text.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses a cell to show full content.
